architecture: Unchanged runLocalGroundedAnalysis actual output audit; gold enters scoring only after extraction.
limitations: Scores actual structured requirements/deadlines, not validator acceptance or arbitrary Q&A answers.
Only deadline, EMD and turnover have direct target mappings in the current text extractor. Other gold fields affect full-corpus coverage but are outside its implemented surface.
Unscorable emissions have no explicit gold for that field and are excluded from value accuracy; their physical source identity is still audited.

Unscorable value outputs can still be unsafe: emissions from adjudicated CONFLICTED cases are separately counted as unsafe unresolved conflicts. Value precision and source-span presence must not be interpreted as safe extraction accuracy.
Source authority, tender identities and extracted_ok are fixture metadata assumptions; ingestion cannot express the original discovery/authority hierarchy.
ID-derived unique filenames provide unambiguous citation document mapping. Generated runtime tender IDs are not compared with procurement tender IDs.
No PDF parsing, OCR execution, network, model inference or live source authentication is exercised.
Changes/tasks repeat extracted values and are counted diagnostically, not as independent facts. Risk scores and generated IDs are not correctness metrics.
Missing extraction is a coverage failure, not a wrong-value emission. Draft ingestion-time deadlines are reported separately and must not be interpreted as supported deadline facts.
Gold-source membership and source-span presence after boundary whitespace trimming are necessary checks; this audit does not establish full citation completeness or general semantic entailment.

Source grounding requires a known authoritative matching-tender document, source-span presence, and gold-source membership when the target field has an adjudicated gold value. Boundary-only whitespace padding is counted as cosmetic.
